naming_convention: snake_case throughout. All monetary values in AED. All ratios as decimal unless _pct suffix (then 0–100 scale).

metrics.name: sale_value_itd
metrics.label: Group Sale Value ITD
metrics.formula: SUM(sale_value_aed) across all active + cancelled bookings
metrics.description: Total contracted sale value of all bookings inception-to-date. Includes active and cancelled units. Group total = AED 86.0B.

metrics.name: active_sale_value_itd
metrics.label: Active Portfolio Sale Value ITD
metrics.description: Sale value of non-cancelled active bookings only. Group = AED 86.97B (R36 Active sheet). Validates hero card portfolio figure.

metrics.name: collected_itd
metrics.label: Collected ITD
metrics.formula: SUM(collected_aed) across all receipt categories ITD
metrics.description: Total receipts collected inception-to-date across all categories (Dues, Advance, New Sales, Other). Group = AED 43.3B.

metrics.name: collected_itd_pct
metrics.label: % Collected ITD
metrics.description: Proportion of total contracted sale value collected to date. Group = 50.3%.

metrics.name: future_milestone_pipeline
metrics.label: Future Milestone Pipeline
metrics.formula: SUM(forward_obligation_aed) for all future collection years from R36
metrics.description: Total forward receivables remaining to be collected from all active bookings. Group = AED 43.5B. CAUTION: three pipeline figures exist (43.5B, ~40B, ~37.8B) representing different scopes — use context-appropriate value.

variants.total_pipeline_43_5B: S04 hero — total forward from R36
variants.opening_book_approx_40B: Narrative approximation for 2025 advance penetration denominator
variants.opening_book_37_8B: Corrected 2026 denominator: 43.5B minus 5.7B prior advances applied

metrics.name: qualified_units
metrics.label: Qualified Units (Active, Excl. PCC)
metrics.formula: COUNT(unit_id) WHERE paid_pct >= 9.5% AND pcc_issued = false
metrics.description: Active booking units with ≥9.5% of sale price collected and PCC not yet issued. App adoption uses 30,044 (excl. PCC); hero card shows 34,731 (all qualified ITD incl. completed). Both must be labelled explicitly.

metrics.name: cancellation_rate_pct
metrics.label: Cancellation Rate
metrics.description: Portfolio-level cancellation rate by value. AED 16.7B cancelled vs AED 103.4B total sold = 16.1%. Significant portfolio risk metric not currently on dashboard.

metrics.name: dues_advance_total
metrics.label: Dues + Advance (D+A)
metrics.description: Core collections metric combining dues and advance receipts. Excludes New Sales, DLD, and Other Charges. 2025 Group = AED 12,966M. WARNING: Finance target includes D+A combined; MDO target tracks dues and advance separately — always label which definition is in use.

metrics.name: total_collections
metrics.label: Total Collections
metrics.description: All receipts across all categories. 2025 Group = AED 16,820M. Sobha = 14,064M; Siniya = 2,506M; DT = 250M.

metrics.name: da_cagr
metrics.label: D+A Collections CAGR
metrics.description: 4-year compound annual growth rate for Dues+Advance from 2021 to 2025. AED 867M (2021) → AED 12,966M (2025) = 97% CAGR.

metrics.name: da_growth_multiple
metrics.label: D+A Growth Multiple
metrics.description: Raw growth multiple for D+A. 2021→2025 = 15×. Total collections = 10.7×. LP charges = 22×.

metrics.name: mix_pct_dues
metrics.label: Dues Mix % of Total
metrics.description: Dues as a share of total collections in a period. Used in the yearwise mix evolution chart (monthly 2021–2025). Tracks structural shift from dues-heavy to advance-balanced portfolio.

metrics.name: mix_pct_advance
metrics.label: Advance Mix % of Total
metrics.description: Advance as a share of total collections. Tracked monthly alongside dues mix to monitor portfolio revenue composition evolution.

metrics.name: mix_pct_new_sales
metrics.label: New Sales Mix % of Total
metrics.description: New sales booking collections as share of total. 2026 Q1 = 473M vs 1.52B MDO target (31%) — critical underperformance flag.

metrics.name: daily_average_collections
metrics.label: Daily Average Collections (MDO)
metrics.description: Required daily run-rate to hit monthly MDO target. Group March target 872M ÷ 22 working days = 46.4M/day. CAUTION: working days are hardcoded at 22 — actual March has ~21 accounting for holidays.

metrics.name: achievement_pct
metrics.label: Collections Achievement %
metrics.description: Actual collections as a percentage of set target. Applies at entity level (MDO/Finance) and at individual collector level. MDO Q1 2026 Dues = 91%. Finance Jan = 118%. Collector range: 29.5%–56%.

metrics.name: mdo_dues_target
metrics.label: MDO Dues Target (Dues-Only)
metrics.description: MDO (Management Defined Objective) target for dues collections ONLY — excludes advance. Jan = 700.5M. FY 2026 = 11.5B. Dynamic targets override static mid-year based on performance trajectory. Do NOT use Finance definition (which bundles D+A).

metrics.name: finance_da_target
metrics.label: Finance D+A Target (Dues + Advance Combined)
metrics.description: Finance department target for Dues+Advance COMBINED. Jan = 909M (vs MDO D+A 1,020M). The gap represents unidentified receipts captured in Finance accounting but not yet tracked in MDO. Always label which target definition is being reported.

metrics.name: mdo_advance_target
metrics.label: MDO Advance Target
metrics.description: MDO advance collections target tracked separately from dues. FY 2026 = AED 4.0B. Q1 = 960M (73% achieved at 702M YTD).

metrics.name: march_collectible_window
metrics.label: March Collectible Window
metrics.description: Total immediately actionable collection pool for March 2026: current OD plus milestones falling due this month. 1,650.1M OD + ~914M March MS = AED 2,564M (2.56B). Distinct from 43.5B which is the multi-year forward pipeline.

metrics.name: od_today
metrics.label: Overdue Today (OD)
metrics.formula: SUM(od_today_aed) from R18 Grand Total row
metrics.description: Total unpaid amount on all milestones whose due date has already passed as of report date. Single source of truth = R18 Grand Total. Grand Total = 1,650.1M (15 Mar 2026). Sobha = 1,472.7M; Siniya = 166.4M; DT = 11.0M. NOTE: this value is a daily-changing figure stored as a static snapshot — will become stale.
metrics.source_of_truth: R18 Grand Total col[4] — do NOT use strategy doc estimate of 1.57B for Sobha

metrics.name: od_pct
metrics.label: OD Rate %
metrics.description: OD expressed as a percentage of total milestone amounts raised (due) inception-to-date. CORRECTED formula — denominator is MS Due ITD (42,505M), NOT purchase price. Group CIV total = 3.88%. Old formula (OD/Purchase Price) understated rates — India was ~2% (wrong), now 4.33% (correct).
metrics.critical_note: OD% = OD / MS_Due_ITD. Never divide by purchase price.

metrics.name: eom_od
metrics.label: End-of-Month OD (EOM OD)
metrics.description: Projected OD at end of current month assuming zero collection occurs. March EOM = AED 2.17B. Used as a risk ceiling metric for monthly planning.

metrics.name: od_ageing_0_30d
metrics.label: OD Ageing 0–30 Days
metrics.description: Current-cycle OD — most recoverable bucket. AED 830M as of 15 Mar 2026 (50.3% of total OD).

metrics.name: od_ageing_31_60d
metrics.label: OD Ageing 31–60 Days
metrics.description: One-cycle-missed OD. AED 445M (27% of total OD).

metrics.name: od_ageing_61_90d
metrics.label: OD Ageing 61–90 Days
metrics.description: Two-cycle-missed OD. AED 166M.

metrics.name: od_ageing_91_120d
metrics.label: OD Ageing 91–120 Days
metrics.description: Three-cycle-missed OD. AED 79M.

metrics.name: od_ageing_121_180d
metrics.label: OD Ageing 121–180 Days
metrics.description: Deep-cycle OD. AED 47M.

metrics.name: od_ageing_180d_plus
metrics.label: OD Ageing 180+ Days
metrics.description: Chronic OD — highest termination risk. AED 225M. Grew from 490M (Jan 2025) to 575M (Dec 2025) before current reading. Monitors chronic delinquency escalation.

metrics.name: dues_efficiency_30d
metrics.label: 30-Day Dues Collection Efficiency
metrics.description: Proportion of the opening overdue book collected within the month. 2025 annual average = 34.8%. Previous incorrect value of 18% (in v3) had no validated basis — do not use.

metrics.name: termination_volume_monthly
metrics.label: Termination Volume (Monthly Average)
metrics.description: Average number of units entering termination-eligible status each month. Apr–Dec 2025 average = 427 units/month.

metrics.name: termination_gap_exposure
metrics.label: Termination Gap Exposure (Not-in-System)
metrics.formula: COUNT(units) WHERE eligible = true AND in_system = false
metrics.description: Units that are termination-eligible but have not been entered into the system — therefore unactioned. 412 units = AED 134.6M unrecovered exposure. Critical operational gap.

metrics.name: cy_advance_mix_pct
metrics.label: Current-Year (CY) Advance Mix %
metrics.description: Advance collected on milestones due within the CURRENT calendar year, as a share of total advance. Jan 2025 = 70.1% (CORRECTED — previous v3 value of 30% was the FY% figure, used in error). Dec 2025 = 0% (all FY by year-end). 2026 YTD = 81.1%.
metrics.critical_note: Jan 2025 CY = 70.1%, NOT 30%. The 30% was the FY share — do not swap.

metrics.name: fy_advance_mix_pct
metrics.label: Future-Year (FY) Advance Mix %
metrics.description: Advance collected on milestones due in FUTURE calendar years, as a share of total advance. Jan 2025 FY = 29.9%. Dec 2025 FY = 100%.

metrics.name: book_penetration_pct
metrics.label: Advance Book Penetration %
metrics.description: Annual advance collected as a % of the opening forward receivables book at the start of that year. 2025 = 8.15% (3,260M ÷ ~40B). 2026 target = 10.6% (4,000M ÷ ~37.8B). Denominator MUST use the year-specific opening book from R36 — NOT a static 40B for both years.
metrics.denominator_note: 2026 opening book = 43.5B pipeline − 5.7B prior advances applied = ~37.8B

metrics.name: advance_lead_time_days
metrics.label: Average Advance Lead Time
metrics.description: Average number of days a customer pays advance before the milestone due date. Historical average = 248 days. Basis for NPV rebate cost calculation.

metrics.name: npv_rebate_rate_pct
metrics.label: NPV Rebate Rate %
metrics.description: Effective NPV cost rate of the advance rebate program. Current applied rate = 3.5%. Proposed optimal rate = 4.3%. Bank equivalent cost = 4.75%. 2026 YTD = 1.4% (9.14M rebate on 641M advance).

metrics.name: npv_incremental_inflow
metrics.label: NPV Incremental Inflow (Rebate Proposal)
metrics.description: Net additional cash inflow from increasing NPV rate from 3.5% to 4.3%. Incremental inflow = AED 652M. Rebate cost at 4.3% = AED 21M vs bank borrowing cost = AED 31M (saving = 10M). NOTE: these are projected modelling figures, not actuals.
metrics.label_requirement: Must be labelled 'projected' in all dashboard displays

metrics.name: collector_achievement_pct
metrics.label: Collector Achievement %
metrics.description: Individual collector's actual collections as % of their assigned target in the period. Range: Top = Walid 56% (39.2M / 70M); Bottom = Ainur 29.5%. Chart must be sorted by achievement% descending — current rendering uses name order (bug).

metrics.name: attempt_intensity
metrics.label: Attempt Intensity
metrics.description: Average number of outreach attempts made per allocated unit. Measures effort depth per collector.

metrics.name: contact_intensity
metrics.label: Contact Intensity
metrics.description: Average number of successful contacts made per allocated unit. Distinct from attempt intensity — measures reach quality, not just volume.

metrics.name: ptp_amount
metrics.label: Promise-to-Pay (PTP) Pipeline
metrics.description: Total AED value of Promise-to-Pay commitments recorded by collectors in Salesforce for the current period. Leading indicator of near-term collections.

metrics.name: bucket_productivity_pct
metrics.label: Bucket Productivity %
metrics.description: Collections achieved as % of OD pool by collector bucket type. FE = 44.1%; OD = 35.4%; Termination = 27.2%.

metrics.name: agent_coverage_pct
metrics.label: Agent Coverage %
metrics.description: Units where at least one Salesforce disposition has been recorded in the current period, as % of total allocated. FE = 99.7%; OD = 99.9%; Termination = 100%; Siniya = 86.2% (198 units unworked, 319M OD pool). Total = 97.1%.

metrics.name: paid_band_distribution
metrics.label: Portfolio Distribution by Paid % Band
metrics.formula: COUNT(units) and SUM(sale_value_aed) grouped by paid_band
metrics.description: Units and sale value segmented by how much of the purchase price has been collected. Bands: 0–10%, 10–20%, 20–30%, 30–40%, 40–60%, 60%+. Key risk: 0–10% = 251 units / 907.7M (IC threshold exposure); 10–20% = 3,496 units / 10.34B.

metrics.name: balance_collectible
metrics.label: Balance Collectible by Paid Band
metrics.description: Remaining amount still to be collected for units in each paid% band. 0–10% band = 887M (highest per-unit risk). 10–20% band = 8.75B (largest absolute balance).

metrics.name: ic_threshold_eligible_units
metrics.label: IC Threshold Eligible Units
metrics.description: Units that would qualify for Internal Cancellation under a given IC threshold. At current 20% threshold: large exposure in 10–20% band (3,496 units). If threshold changes to 10%: 251 units (907.7M) immediately eligible. BOARD BUSINESS CASE REQUIRED before any threshold change.

metrics.name: pr_approval_rate_pct
metrics.label: PR First-Pass Approval Rate %
metrics.description: Payment Receipts approved on first submission without rework. Dec 2025 sample (n=1,818): 51% approved; 27% rejected for doc gaps; 23% rejected for manual errors. Drives the AED 250–300M visibility gap from uncommitted PRs.

metrics.name: pr_doc_gap_rate_pct
metrics.label: PR Rejection Rate — Document Gaps
metrics.description: Share of PRs rejected due to missing or incorrect supporting documentation. Dec 2025 = 27%. Target = 0% via Interim PR Module (P1 roadmap item).

metrics.name: pr_manual_error_rate_pct
metrics.label: PR Rejection Rate — Manual Errors
metrics.description: Share of PRs rejected due to data entry or processing errors. Dec 2025 = 23%.

metrics.name: pcc_tat_days
metrics.label: PCC Turnaround Time (TAT)
metrics.description: Calendar days from 100% payment completion to Possession Completion Certificate issuance. Pre-initiative average = 20 days. Post-initiative (Q4 2025+) = 3–5 days. Target = 2 days.

metrics.name: pr_to_soa_tat_0_2d_pct
metrics.label: PR-to-SOA Turnaround % in 0–2 Days
metrics.description: Proportion of Payment Receipts processed with Statement-of-Account updated within 2 calendar days. 2024 = 25%; 2025 = 35%; 2026 YTD = 51%. Target = maximize this band.

metrics.name: app_payment_share_pct
metrics.label: App Payment Channel Share %
metrics.description: One Sobha App as share of all D+A payment transactions by COUNT (not value). 2024 = 0.1%; 2025 = 6%; 2026 YTD = 25.9%. Fastest-growing channel. App adoption (units with app downloaded) = 57% of active base; target = 90%.
metrics.basis: Transaction COUNT basis — do not use AED value for this metric

metrics.name: helpdesk_within_tat_pct
metrics.label: Helpdesk Cases Resolved Within TAT %
metrics.description: Proportion of helpdesk cases closed within defined SLA turnaround time. 2026 YTD = 85.5% (120,700 cases closed). Feb 2026 peak = 93.4%.

metrics.name: call_audit_coverage_pct
metrics.label: Call Audit Coverage %
metrics.description: QCG audit coverage of outbound collector calls. Current = 30%. Target = 100%. Gap to close via AI-Driven Audit roadmap item (P3, Q1 2027).

metrics.name: sla_tat_compliance_pct
metrics.label: SLA TAT Compliance %
metrics.description: Proportion of all operational tasks completed within defined SLA. Current = 87%. Target = 90%.

metrics.name: nationality_od_pct
metrics.label: OD Rate by Nationality
metrics.description: OD as a % of milestones due ITD, segmented by customer nationality. India = 4.33% (272M OD, highest absolute); Iran = 9.14% (highest rate); Russia = 2.36%; China = 1.73%; Netherlands = 10.02% (highest rate by nationality).

metrics.name: civ_od_pct
metrics.label: OD Rate by CIV Band
metrics.description: OD rate segmented by Customer Investment Value tier. Group CIV total = 3.88% (1,650M / 42,505M MS Due). Highest rate: 60–100M CIV band = 31.58%. R38 adds paid% dimension to CIV analysis for risk heat map.

critical_definitions.od_pct_denominator: ALWAYS use ms_due_itd_aed as denominator. NEVER use purchase_price_aed. Using purchase price understates delinquency (e.g. India: 2% wrong → 4.33% correct).
critical_definitions.finance_vs_mdo_target: Finance target = D+A combined. MDO target = Dues-only (separate advance target). The two systems show different achievement% for same actual. Label explicitly in every report.
critical_definitions.cy_vs_fy_advance: CY = advance on milestones due in current calendar year. FY = advance on future-year milestones. Jan 2025 CY = 70.1%; Jan 2025 FY = 29.9%. Previous error swapped these.
critical_definitions.active_vs_all_qualified_units: active_excl_pcc = 30,044 (for app adoption, coverage). all_qualified_itd = 34,731 (for portfolio count). Use context-appropriate value and label clearly.
critical_definitions.pipeline_figures: 43.5B = total forward pipeline (R36). ~40B = approximate opening 2025 book (narrative only). 37.8B = corrected 2026 opening book for penetration denominator. These are three distinct numbers.
